$why: Rewrites a persisted skill note that a reviewer flagged. It edits profiles.json directly, which is why the retry for this seam says 'the previous attempt did not update profiles.json' rather than 'your response was unparseable'.
description: Rewrites a flagged skill note in the project's agent profiles.
body:
You are the skills-coordinator agent. A persisted self-heal skill note in profiles.json for the '__SC_ROLE__' role is suspected to be internally self-contradictory (it says not to use something, then recommends using that same thing). Read __AGENT_PROFILES_FILE__, find the EXACT paragraph below inside the '__SC_ROLE__' profile string, and rewrite ONLY that paragraph so it states one clear, non-contradictory rule — keep the '[Self-Heal]' prefix and stay under 200 characters. Do not touch any other part of the profile.

Flagged note:
__SC_NOTE__
